## Body

For an account-only scrub, assert that each new file exactly equals its prior content after an enumerated set of account-label/placeholder substitutions and necessary punctuation/backtick adjustments. Merely requiring every changed line to contain the removed login is too weak. Check modes/renames, preserve other accounts and numeric/state/timing evidence, and scan all tracked HEAD files (including hidden and generated files) without printing the removed value.

The failed historical row is now preserved modulo anonymization, not literally byte-for-byte. The earlier close-out note retains the acceptance tally and s06 boundaries; do not duplicate or upgrade those claims.
